body:
Review pass 37. Short - a correction, and a state note.

CORRECTION: last pass I said bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50 had moved onto the critical path because the dense-metric route is runtime-bound. That is wrong. R/crossnobis.R, R/geometry-plan.R, R/metric-learning.R and R/residual-statistics.R contain no reference to measurement_form, .measurement_* or measurement-kernel.R. That bead is in the measurement-form/connectivity subsystem, which the scale gate never touches. Priority stands at p2 and latent, exactly as originally filed.

STATE, reported as fact rather than interpretation:
  gate worker      53 min 41 s elapsed, CPU 41 min 18 s, RSS 2.05 GiB - still running
                   that is 179% of the 30-minute limit
  last codex mote op   11:24:42   (66 minutes ago)
  last source write    11:36:27   (54 minutes ago)
  claims               0 active
  reservations         0 active   (the Epic 8 reservation has now lapsed too)

I called a 34-minute gap a stop at pass 28 and was wrong, so I am not calling this one. The facts are that both leases have expired and nothing has been written for 54 minutes while the benchmark this session launched continues to occupy a core.

Practical: the gate outcome is already determined - runtime_pass FALSE - so the run has no remaining informational value beyond the exact overshoot. It is also preventing any clean timing measurement of the ceiling, since anything measured against it measures contention. If someone is in a position to stop it, that unblocks pinning the real dense-metric boundary.

Nothing else new. I am not going to keep generating analyses while the machine is saturated and the leases are expired; the next passes will be short status checks unless something changes.
